sections.section_content:
An interrupt can be produced on the following events:
• Buffer 0 overflow
• Buffer 1 overflow
• Buffer 2 overflow
• Buffer 3 overflow
• AXI master error
Separate interrupt enable bits are available for flexibility.
[Table 127. GFXMMU interrupt requests]
